title: atlas(#5670 §8): historical archive/delete — swap-2026-11-03 evidence archive + transfer artifacts (laptop, gated)

labels.name: task/small-fix
labels.description: Queue packet kind: bounded fix with reproduction and targeted tests

body:
Slice of #5670 (§8, historical rows). Laptop-side work (items marked † in the design are on amd-6).

**Rows:**
1. `~/atlas/v3/swap-2026-11-03/` (~40 one-off swap/gate/remediation scripts) + `staging.db` (462 MB) → archive as the hatch-personal#20 evidence record. **Gate:** only after the in-flight index rewrite completes and verifies. Do not touch while the rewrite runs.
2. Transfer artifacts: `/home/hatch/atlas-model-rev.tar` (1.2 GB), `atlas-step6-closure.nar` (300 MB), `~/tmp/atlas-migrate/`, `~/tmp/atlas-parts/`, assorted proof/backup logs → delete once the provisioned model + nix closure are confirmed reproducible from developing-today/code (~1.5 GB reclaimed). The destination provisioning path (#5355) is closed and the seat wrapper already provisions the model from hash-verified pins — the reproducibility confirmation is a recorded check on this issue, then the delete.

**Acceptance:** per-row gate evidence recorded here; archive/delete commits or commands recorded; #5670 updated with the final acceptance grep (hatch-personal + ~/tools + ~/atlas: no remaining live Atlas script outside the repo).
